nomination: At most3 source configurations; nominate and freeze all before inspecting any positive-temperature candidate outputs. Failed or nonbeneficial greedy screens do not need nomination.
tests: For each of3contexts: all14single-tokenpositions plus adjacentpairs starting0,1,5,6,11,12; total60percomparison. Encode ended sequences as absorbingSTOP so lengths do not condition token marginals on survival.
statistics: Pearson contingency with exact SciPy survivalfunction, no Yates correction. Pool categories symmetrically by pooled marginal frequencies to keep expected cells>=5; if rare-pool mass is too small merge it into the largest pooled category. Degenerate tests are uninformative withp=1. Holm correction across the prespecified maximum180 tests (unused comparisons paddedp=1). Report effect sizes, sample counts and all unadjusted/adjustedp values.
interpretation: Regression screen for gross sampling-distribution errors; no rejection is not proof of equivalence. Small/rare differences have limited power. Independent seed arms, rather than treating same-seed output equality as the correctness test. Greedy equality and independent operator equations remain separate checks.
source: SciPy official chi2_contingency documentation, observed2026-11-10, v1.18.0; modern statistical result replaces the archived study Wilson-Hilferty approximation.
